config.entry: trigger-day OPEN (Monday, or Tuesday when Monday is a holiday), equal weight across targets with data
config.sizing: notional = |score| * equity at entry (score in [0.5, 1.0]); overlapping T+5 trades can stack gross exposure

rules.stop_tp: hard stop -8% / TP +15% / max hold T+5 close; intraday, stop checked before TP; gap through level exits at open
rules.trail_half: exit at close when close gives back 50% of best close profit; hard stop -8%; max hold T+5
rules.signal_decay: hold while the signal fires; exits at the LAST fire day close (signal fires Mon AND Tue for the same weekend, so normally T+1 close)

config.max_eval_lag_note: verified empirically: the signal fires on BOTH Monday and Tuesday for the same flagged weekend

conventions.look_ahead: entry uses the trigger day's open after the signal fired (signal reads only data strictly before as_of); exits use only bars up to the exit day
conventions.windows: events assigned by ENTRY date; OOS 2021-01-01..2023-03-02 and training 2023-04-01..2026-09-11 mirror scripts/backtest_outofsample.py (gap in 2023-03 intentional)
conventions.boundary_trades: a trade entered near a window end keeps its REAL exit for stats but is marked at the window's last close in the equity curve
conventions.end_of_data: trades whose exit would fall beyond 2026-09-11 exit at the last close, reason end_of_data
conventions.shorting: allowed in long_short mode; borrow costs not modeled
conventions.skipped_legs: COIN before its 2021-04-14 IPO is skipped and recorded
conventions.win_rate: event-level: an event wins when its net-of-cost pnl (all legs) > 0
conventions.tax_note: holding period <= 1 year -> short-term capital gains taxed as ordinary income; all rules here hold <= ~1 week

signal_decay_check.note: signal_decay exits at the LAST fire day close; the signal fires Mon+Tue, so this equals T+1 close except when the entry itself was a Tuesday (Monday holiday: the 2-day eval window is exhausted on entry day, so it exits at the entry-day close = T+0)
